items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Keg Johnson and Budd Johnson and those fellows

ctx.x: You know, you're so very much right about the Benny Carter laboratory. I don't know whether it was official or not, but you must put John Hammond in there, who always liked Benny Carter, and he was the one who... Remember in 1932, he was the one that John Hammond recommended... He'd heard Teddy Wilson in Chicago, and told Benny Carter "Why don't you send for Teddy Wilson?" So Teddy Wilson came into New York to play with Benny Carter's band on the suggestion of John Hammond. And of course, when he got there, he'd…
